To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the SiOxN y etching process in CF4 + X (X is a C4F8, CF2Br2, or C2F6) + O2 gas chemistries proceeds in the neutral-flux limited regime and the etching rate is determined by the SiOx Ny + F reaction probability, which depends on the gas composition, input power, and pressure.

the SiOxNx etching process in CF4 + CF4/X + O2 gas systems (X = C2F6, CF2Br2, C4F8) is characterized by the neutral-fluorine-atom-limited regime with the reaction probability that is determined by the balance of fluorocarbon deposition and removal processes.

the SiOxN y reactive-ion etching performance in CF4 + CF 2Br2 +O2 and CF4 + C4F8 +O2 gas chemistries is similar and that the CF4 + CFBr2 + O 2 chemistry is preferable in the sense that it is less sensitive to process conditions and has more vertical etch profile.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CF2Br2 is a suitable alternative to C4F8 in the CF4 + OX gas mixtures for the SiOxNy reactive-ion etching processes in the low power regime.
the CF4 + CFxBr2 + O 2 system is a good candidate for the SiOxNx etching in the low power regime.
the CF4 + CF3Br + O2 system can be considered a good alternative to the CF4 + C4F8 + O2 chemistry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CF4/X = 1:1 gas mixture with CF2Br2 additive is an alternative to C4F8 additive in CF4 + C4F8 + O2 system for low power SiOxNy RIE applications.
both gas chemistries are equally suitable to etch SiOxNy layers in a low power and low pressure regime, and CF4 + CF 2Br2 +O2 is slightly better than CF4 + C4F8 + O2.
both CF4 + CF4F8 + O2 and CF4 + CFBr2 + O gas mixtures can be used in the SiOxNx etching process in the low power regime, with CF4 + CFx + O2 being more suitable for high aspect ratio structures.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CF2Br2 is a suitable additive component for CF4/O2 gas chemistries and can be recommended as an alternative to C4F8 for the SiOxNx etching processes.
